title: Research: sharp signed-connector cost with paid root doubling and halving
body:
The signed three-by-three connector in PR944/PR1088 needs 14 ordinary child queries in its original alphabet. Adding **paid root doubling and halving** permits **13 child queries plus two scaling passes**, with all dirty state restored. For positive fixed complete prices equal between query signs, the extended alphabet has exact optimum

`2 sum_F c_F + min(2 c_min, c_min + d + h)`.

Thus the change helps exactly when both scaling passes together cost less than the child call removed. A normalization argument rules out 12 queries even with arbitrarily many allowed root scalings; an independently enumerated 720-path certificate completes that reduction. All six cheapest-operator choices and all 288 signed/permuted matrices are covered.

**Status: scoped complex circuit and fixed-price theorem. No new kappa or selected-supplier admission.** The concrete factor fixture uses 304 factor calls plus two complete root scans, versus 308 factor calls. At length three, the literal dense data-tape invoice falls from 837,128 to 835,044 head moves, including both scans. These are operation counts, not a runtime benchmark.

Only `research/complex-dyadic-connector-seed30/` is added. It contains the written proof, exact short and expanded words, source pins, local claim, explicit replay manifest and meaningful failure controls.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-dyadic-connector-seed30/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_COMPLEX_DYADIC_CONNECTOR` with 720 paths, 288 matrices, 3,456 query maps, 24 free factor maps, 240 dense dirty-basis maps and 191 semantic controls. Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized Python 3.11/3.14 runs, read-only relocation, source/receipt corruption controls, and the unchanged PR944 verifier pass locally. Selected source bindings are unchanged. Native hosting, rounded precision, the selected cold replay and the full multiplication theorem are not claimed.

OS assignment seed: **30**, complex-supplier track. Exact base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`.

Credit Ross Richardson's PR944 (`5dbcfbc63f646de5a1354f6b9760ec03837233f0`) and @martinxxx9's six repairs in PR1088 (`b0396aad724fec58630fbd4d13a809c562f18d9e`), reused as pinned data. Concurrent PR1349 (`8adb25ce6d2090de170e241a170668e8fd7cf5a2`) reaches thirteen signed queries over F3; this contribution instead changes the paid operation alphabet in characteristic zero. The final overlap search covered 765 open PRs and 198 discussion records, with complete pagination and no warnings; its search limits are retained in TASK.json.

Prepared by Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in reasoning, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; no independent human or proof-assistant review claimed.
